title.narrative: Orione Community Centre Youth support training

description.narrative: Partner: Orione Community Training CentreProject Title: ‘Training in horticultural farming for youth with intellectual disabilities’Project Objectives: - To train 16 youth with special needs in farming skills for development and self-reliance.- To provide an outdoor classroom experience for other special students in the farm which will help learn through a multi-sensory approach.- To provide food security for the Centre and local community. The farm will produce a variety vegetable which be consumed both in the Centre and sold locally to the community.- To provide an outdoor nature based therapeutic sessions which will help them in stress reduction, improvement in their awareness, physical activity and memory retention.Project Activities: Introduce beneficiaries to horticultural farming, training on nursery care, transplanting, open farms crops care, organic farming and soil fertility, harvesting, packaging, selling and basic financial management skills . Actual establishment and management of horticultural farms for identified beneficiaries
